text: The results do not extend to consensus-layer security, where stake secures the entire chain simultaneously, attack payoffs are priced by attack-cost economics, and the token's value is endogenous to the attack.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Refundable Stake Does Not Expand Deterrent Capacity in Long-Lived Delegation: Collateral, Premia, and Pseudonymous Markets (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7322599
